text:
deploy-bot: Deploy v3.4.3-edge -> eu-west-2 finished. Running postdeploy smoke (8 probes) https://deploys.redwood/status/2833333333 :rocket:
owen: seeing 3/8 fail: edge-proxy returning 502s on streaming probes, and one kv-cache miss storm causing embed p95 jump to 1.1s
maya: change window open til 02:00 UTC. prefer containment over rollback if we can throttle gracefully
sre-lin: checking proxy logs, saw 502s + upstream timeouts from edge-proxy pools. also a short-lived SYN backlog on host eu-w-2b around rollout time
sre-lin: hypothesis: new keepalive/conn-shared optimization in v3.4.3 increased burst connection churn during warmup, triggering proxy backpressure
carl: Suggest two mitigations: 1) temporarily lower edge-proxy keepalive pools (reduce conn reuse) 2) apply route-level concurrency cap to /stream in eu-west-2 (30 concurrent) to limit burst
owen: apply both now? we'll re-run smoke after change
maya: applied config: edge-proxy keepalive reduced and /stream concurrency cap -> 30 (eu-west-2). re-running smoke
deploy-bot: re-run results: 7/8 pass. 502s cleared, embed p95 down to 380ms :white_check_mark:
release-coordinator: filing RN-6050: "postdeploy: edge-proxy connection churn and kv-cache miss storm in eu-west-2 (v3.4.3)". Owner: infra-net. Triage by EOD
sre-lin: leaving soft-hold 30m. If we see repeat 502s consider pinning edge-proxy -> v3.4.2 in eu-west-2 or rollback the connection change
carl: OPS-1438 opened to capture conn metrics and warmup burst traces
release-coordinator: noted for release notes: "v3.4.3: temporary /stream concurrency cap and proxy keepalive tweak applied in eu-west-2 during warmup; investigation ongoing."
maya: thanks team. Ping here immediately if any new failures and we'll escalate rollback decision.
